scope: Read-only source review of the unbound metadata reader template and its fixed source plan. This review does not authorize binding, admission, B access, or execution.

findings.detail: The inventory calls Path.exists() before lstat()/is_symlink(). Path.exists() returns false for a dangling symlink, so a fixed export path can be reported as absent without exposing or rejecting the symlink. This makes the stated stat-only inventory incomplete for partial/failure states.
findings.required_repair: Use lstat-first existence detection; report or fail on every symlink, including dangling symlinks, before recording absence. Add a focused dangling-symlink fixture.

findings.detail: The function fully enumerates root.rglob('cgroup.procs') before enforcing the 128-file limit and uses unbounded Path.read_text() for every populated cgroup.procs and cgroup counter. A large cgroup subtree or process list can consume unbounded traversal time and memory and can make the emitted JSON stdout unbounded.
findings.required_repair: Bound descendant enumeration while walking, read each cgroup metadata file through a no-follow bounded reader with per-file and aggregate byte ceilings, and fail closed when any bound is exceeded. Add focused synthetic fixtures for traversal/file/aggregate limits.

decision: Do not bind or run this template. Preserve this review as a negative snapshot; review any versioned repair against its own exact source pin.
